subject.title: fix(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol Pro effort

question: Should Oracle permanently expose `--browser-thinking-time pro` as a CLI-only value that is valid only with selected GPT-5.6 Sol and fails closed for every other model strategy or target?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but accepting a new public CLI value and its strict provider-routing semantics is a product contract decision rather than a mechanical bug-fix judgment.

options.title: Approve CLI-only Pro
options.body: Land the guarded CLI/browser capability while preserving the existing persistent configuration and MCP contracts.

options.title: Wait for inventory redesign
options.body: Defer this narrow capability until the broader data-driven picker proposal at https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/319 has a confirmed direction.

options.title: Keep generic Pro only
options.body: Decline version-specific Pro effort selection and retain the existing generic `gpt-5-pro` target behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve CLI-only Pro
recommendation.body: Land the guarded CLI/browser capability while preserving the existing persistent configuration and MCP contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and recent work on the same browser model-selection contract make this the strongest available decision owner.
